buildToolContract.invocationCi: backend/gradlew -p tools/pdpa-lint clean check pdpaLint -PpdpaLint.changedFrom=origin/<target> -PpdpaLint.branch=<source or commit branch>
options: --config <file> (default: tools/pdpa-lint/pdpa-lint.yaml, relative to the repository root)
--rules-out <file> (default: tools/pdpa-lint/build/pdpa-rules.yaml, relative to the repository root)
--run-date <YYYY-MM-DD> (default: today in Asia/Bangkok; injectable for the expiry tests)
--changed-files-from-git <target> (optional; when absent the list is not built)
--branch <name> (required with --changed-files-from-git; missing, empty or HEAD gives exit 2)
buildToolContract.trigger: Every pipeline .gitlab-ci.yml creates: merge request, branch and tag, through the job's own rules. Locally, scripts/dev.ps1 test before the orchestrator's merge, and the pdpa-lint command.
inputs: Dictionary: infra/postgres/schema/03-recovery-physical-schema-v6.sql as the baseline, then every *.sql in the folder from rwb.flyway.location (backend/src/main/resources/db/modulemigration/recovery) in Flyway order, then dictionary.files (empty by default). Recognised forms R1 and R2; the ignored class; every other sys_fields write fails closed with exit 2.
API specification: api/recovery-api-v4.yaml, properties with x-personal-data: true, object = snake case of the schema name, field = snake case of the property.

Scan roots, exclusions, lint-fixture roots, fixtureObjects, synthetic prefix, example domains, matcher names, logger names, exception types, masking helpers, entity suffixes: tools/pdpa-lint/pdpa-lint.yaml.
Allow list: tools/pdpa-lint/pdpa-allow.yaml (empty sequence in production).

Migration folder: read from rwb.flyway.location in backend/src/main/resources/application.yaml, classpath: mapped to backend/src/main/resources/. The configuration may only repeat it; a mismatch, a missing property or a non-classpath value gives exit 2.

Changed-file list: git merge-base <target> HEAD and git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AMR <base>..HEAD, built only when the target equals changedFiles.targetBranch (develop-recovery) and the branch is neither that branch nor a protected one (main, develop). Repository metadata only; no database and no network.
buildToolContract.generated: tools/pdpa-lint/build/pdpa-rules.yaml on every run that completes the dictionary, before scanning; deterministic; not committed; kept as a CI artifact with the console log.
buildToolContract.outputLine: {rule}: {file}:{line} uses personal field {field}. Remove it or use the masking helper.
buildToolContract.fieldTokenForm: {dictionary field name} ({matched token}) when the token differs, for example last_name (lastName)

exitCodes.2: configuration or input error: an unreadable configuration, dictionary or API file; an unsupported sys_fields statement; a duplicate seed field_id across migrations; an UPDATE of an unknown field_id; an empty dictionary; an invalid allow entry or any allow entry whose path would match the migration folder; a scan configuration that excludes or omits the migration folder or lets a lint-fixture root cover it; a lint-fixture root outside the test roots; a migration folder that does not match rwb.flyway.location; a corrective migration naming an unknown file; a source that cannot be parsed; where the list is built, a target that cannot be resolved or has no merge base; --changed-files-from-git with --branch missing, empty or HEAD. A lint-fixture file never gives exit 2 from its content.

errorLines: allow entry on a migration: entries[{n}]
scan configuration excludes the migration folder: {config key}
lint-fixture root outside the test roots: {config key}
migration folder does not match rwb.flyway.location: {config key}
changed-file list: target branch {name} not found
changed-file list: no merge base with {name}
buildToolContract.neverPrinted: Any value found, any source line or SQL statement text, any fixture value, any secret or credential (BR7; SPEC-TE011-012). Every system test asserts this.
buildToolContract.state: None between runs; a failed run is repeated by rerunning the pipeline. The same commit, configuration and dictionary give the same output.
notices: PDPA-NOTICE: {file}:{line} object not resolved for {field}; add a fixtureObjects entry or a typed receiver
PDPA-NOTICE: {file}:{line} seeds {field}, marked personal by a later migration
scopeLines: PDPA-SCOPE: lint fixtures {config key} {glob} holds {n} files
PDPA-SCOPE: changed-file list not built: target {target}, branch {name}
buildToolContract.outputOrder: findings (sorted by file, line, rule, field), expired-allow lines for matched entries, notices (sorted the same way), four counts, then scope lines (exclusions, lint fixtures, class counts, changed-file decision). Exit 2 prints exactly one error line and nothing else.
buildToolContract.fixtureMatching: See plan/data-model.md section 5 and spec SPEC-TE011-008: (object, field) keys from object_name.field_name, source_field table.column and API schema.property; a position is resolved only when the dictionary describes that field on that object; unresolved positions use the unambiguous-name rule, with API personal names always findings in API-typed positions and ambiguous names reported as notices. SQL is classified in four classes; columns not named, statements not recognised and DML in a procedural body are findings with those literal field labels. DEFAULT literal positions are checked; NULL, empty string and DEFAULT are never findings.
buildToolContract.correctiveMigration: See plan/data-model.md section 5.4 and spec SPEC-TE011-018: only files in the recovery migration folder; line 2 of C starts '-- Fix:' with a non-empty reason and names each original as V[0-9]{4}__[A-Za-z0-9_]+.sql; conditions (a) later sequence, (b) same line-1 story key, (c) names O, (d) writes each readable target table (and changes a literal DEFAULT column), (e) O not on the changed-file list where that list is built. An accepted finding becomes a corrected-by notice. An unknown named file gives exit 2.

changedFiles.builtWhen: target without origin/ equals changedFiles.targetBranch (default develop-recovery) and branch is neither that branch nor a protected branch (default main, develop)
changedFiles.notBuiltWhen: any other target, a run on the target or a protected branch, or no option; no git command runs and condition (e) is not evaluated
changedFiles.failClosed: target not found, no merge base, or --branch missing, empty or HEAD gives exit 2; never an empty list
